correctness.rationale: A vertex-by-vertex local argument rules out every excitation at time 2 for all m>=1: a time-one excited leaf requires its adjacent hub to be time-one refractory, and a time-one excited paired leaf requires its opposite leaf to be time-one refractory. Thus F^3=0. A sharp initial coloring makes a hub newly excited at time one. Exact enumeration of allowed initial page pairs by nine initial hub assignments yields S_m, from which all first-hit counts and the 8/9 limit follow algebraically. The standalone direct program exhaustively checked 5,380,830 distinct configurations at m=1..6; a separate coefficient implementation checked the nine-case sum for m=1..30. Finite checks are corroboration, not proof of all m.

value.rationale: Changing the local contact threshold on a canonical many-cycle graph produces a sharp phase collapse from persistent period-three/four oscillations to uniform bounded-time absorption. The all-m exact first-hitting-time law is a natural invariant of this change; its 8/9 limiting last-time mass gives quantitative macroscopic content not supplied by the prior extinction criterion. It is a complete motivated infinite-family temporal classification, not an isolated arithmetic instance.
